LeetCode links come from the reference sheet and were checked against the LeetCode problem catalog (slug exists).
The reference sheet lists no GFG links; GFG links were matched against the GFG practice catalog (exact title, or hand-reviewed close match). Problems without a confident match have no GFG link.
One LeetCode link (a2z-45 Intersection of two sorted arrays) was supplied by the project owner and confirmed in the LeetCode catalog.
